Liberation War Affairs Minister withdraws comment on barring the unvaccinated from going out
2021-08-04T13:54:43+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/governance/news/liberation-war-affairs-minister-withdraws-comment-barring-the-unvaccinated-going-out-2144581

Amid wide criticism on social media since yesterday, Liberation War Affairs Minister AKM Mozammel Haque has withdrawn the comment he made yesterday that unvaccinated people, aged 18 and above, will not be allowed to go out.

Part of Liberation War Affairs Minister's statement that "Anyone above 18 years will not be allowed on streets and on any mode of transport unless they are vaccinated" has been withdrawn, according to a press release of the ministry.

All citizens over the age of 18 will be vaccinated in phases, it said.
